privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must extract data from eia.gov. Expected data ranges: Texas production > 15,000 Trillion Btu, Rank < 5, Price < 20 cents. California production < 10,000 Trillion Btu, Rank < 15, Price > 20 cents. West Virginia production < 10,000 Trillion Btu, Rank < 25, Price < 20 cents. The bookmark folder must be exactly 'Grid Analysis'. The output file must be at '/home/ga/Documents/energy_comparison.json'.
